panel.truth_blind_masks: 32 unique masks generated before truth by SHA256(frame_sha256 || ':R15E2:' || counter), interpreted modulo 2^16, skipping duplicates/adversarial masks
panel.selection_firewall: No SAT/UNSAT label and no candidate outcome participates in hash-derived selection. The five adversarial masks are previously exposed k4 false positives and are deliberately retained as frozen stress controls.

verification.order: Candidate must complete first. Then for each panel mask, exact DPLL is run independently on the original frame restricted to that bridge assignment and on the frozen candidate extended interface restricted to the same bridge assignment.
verification.match: original_exists == candidate_exists_aux for every panel mask
verification.full_domain_claim: FORBIDDEN; this is a finite semantic calibration panel, not exhaustive equivalence.

claim_ceiling: A panel MATCH only authorizes prospective unseen-world testing with the candidate frozen. It does not prove full W05 equivalence, polynomial scaling, SAT in P, or P=NP.
